name: What types of services are included in an AEO package for accounting firms?

mainEntity.name: What types of services are included in an AEO package for accounting firms?

acceptedAnswer.text: A comprehensive AEO package for accounting firms typically includes several services. These often encompass search engine optimization (SEO) tailored for accounting keywords, pay-per-click (PPC) campaign management, content marketing strategy for thought leadership, social media optimization, and advanced analytics reporting. Some packages may also include AI-powered tools for reputation management, lead qualification, or website personalization, all designed to enhance your firm's digital performance.
acceptedAnswer.description: AEO packages for accounting firms usually include SEO, PPC, content marketing, social media optimization, and analytics, with optional AI tools for lead management.
